product_overview: OrbitAI is an Autonomous Software Architect platform that accelerates the software development lifecycle from ideation to prototyping and testing by leveraging advanced AI technologies. It assists users in brainstorming, planning, visualizing, generating, and autonomously testing software projects with real-time collaboration and governance capabilities.
core_goals: Bridge the gap between rough ideas and production-ready software specifications.
Reduce analysis paralysis by guiding users through the planning phase.
Abstract complex architectural decisions to simplify project design.
Generate interactive prototypes instantly from textual requirements.
Autonomously test and verify software prototypes using AI-driven agents.
Provide real-time project maturity assessments and compliance monitoring.
Enable seamless collaboration and governance throughout the development process.
key_features: Computer Use Agent (CUA) for autonomous testing with live video streaming of AI interactions.
Neural Stream Chat with multi-model AI routing for intelligent brainstorming and ideation.
Instant prototype generation supporting React and Tailwind with live preview and interactive editing.
Real-time maturity assessment engine evaluating project readiness across multiple criteria.
Mission Control dashboard with progress visualization, Kanban boards, and milestone tracking.
Collaborative workspace with multi-user presence, live cursors, and conflict resolution.
Intelligent support widget integrating AI and human agents with ticket management.
Comprehensive admin and governance dashboard for compliance, cost estimation, and monitoring.
user_flow_summary: User begins in the Neural Stream Chat to ideate and build a mind map of the project concept.
AI assists in refining project details and improves maturity score through guided questions.
User triggers prototype generation that instantly creates working React/Tailwind code and displays it live.
User activates the Computer Use Agent to autonomously test the prototype while watching live AI interactions.
User reviews test results and project maturity assessments to ensure readiness.
User exports project plans, compliance checklists, and cost estimates for handover to engineering.
Throughout, users collaborate in real-time with multi-user presence and unified workspace management.
validation_criteria: Functional prototype generation with live preview matches user requirements.
Computer Use Agent accurately autonomously generates and executes test scenarios.
Real-time maturity scoring engine updates appropriately with user input and project changes.
Neural Stream Chat maintains context and dynamically switches between AI models based on task.
Collaborative workspace reflects multi-user edits without conflicts and updates live.
Admin dashboards display accurate compliance and cost estimation data.
User support system correctly routes between AI and human agents and manages tickets effectively.
